items.text: I’ll generate the thumbnail now, using the reference image to keep Akatsuki’s shape faithful and emphasizing the exact Japanese text and quiet cinematic mood you described.
Ideogram 4 cannot use a reference image, so I’ll switch to a model that supports image guidance while keeping the same prompt and exact specs.

Here is the thumbnail.

Composition checks:
- Aspect ratio and size: 1280×672 (≈1.9:1) ✓
- Akatsuki: gold box body, blue solar paddles above and below, dark gray bell nozzle at the bottom center, with a faint blue-white thrust on the lower-left side ✓
- Venus: large cloud limb on the right, cream-to-ocher tones with a thin atmospheric glow at the edge ✓
- Title: “五年後、また会おう” in large white bold gothic with black outline ✓
- Subtitle: “金星を逃した探査機が歩いた、静かな執念の軌道” with “静かな執念” highlighted in yellow ✓
- Top-right meta: “Akatsuki 2010 → 2015” in small white ✓
- No watermark, signature, logo, CTA, emoji, or hashtag ✓

Please let me know if you want any adjustments to text size/placement, spacecraft size, or Venus color balance.
